title: Trump Goes to Desperate Efforts for His Must-Win MAGA Candidate
text:
The anxious president has found two “political hacks” to blame.
President Donald Trump has pointed his finger at two of his Republican foes in a desperate attempt to steer voting back to his must-win candidate.
Texas Attorney General Paxton, 63, is in a tight Senate race with Democrat James Talarico, 37. The last Democrat elected to the Senate from Texas was Lloyd Bentsen in 1988.have Talarico in the lead, as much as by four points, according to ReconMR/Siena calculations. Election site Decision Desk gives Talarico a 56 percent chance to flip the Texas Senate seat.
Paxton over incumbent Senator John Cornyn in May, and strategically held the Republican National Midterm Convention in Dallas last month, where he continued to throw his support behind Paxton. However, as Paxton struggles in the polls, Trump has already flagged he will blame Cornyn and former White House adviser Karl Rove if his pick loses, while pleading with voters to switch to Paxton.
“Sadly, and very stupidly, John Cornyn, and his Liddle’ Buddy, Super RINO, Karl Rove, are doing everything possible to make it hard for Ken Paxton, the Greatest Attorney General in the History of Texas, and one of the Best in the United States, to win the upcoming Midterm Election against a Radical Left Lunatic, James TalaFREAKO, who is the ANTITHESIS of Texas Values,” Trump vented onThe president claimed Cornyn “lost the Primary to Ken by a very wide margin” after he endorsed Paxton, and insisted Rove “shouldn’t be allowed to spew his jealously on FoxNews,” then added they “should be ashamed of themselves. ”in May, ending three decades of Cornyn’s electoral dominance.
Paxton took home 63.8 percent of the votes compared to Cornyn’s 36.2, according to the President Donald Trump and Republican Senate candidate Ken Paxton attend a campaign rally at Freeman Coliseum in San Antonio, Texas, October 7, 2026.opinion piece last month that he would vote for Democrat Jon Rosenthal over Republican Bo French in the race for a seat on the Texas Railroad Commission.
“The GOP’s stables need a cleaning,” he wrote, adding it was only the second time he has ever voted for a Democrat. “This is a good place to start. ”Stating the pair are hurting both Texas and the U.S., Trump said in his Truth Social post Thursday, “If Ken Paxton loses, it will be because of WEAK and INEFFECTIVE Political Hacks like John Cornyn and Karl Rove, who have ineffectively opposed me for my entire political career.
”A desperate Trump then begged, stating, “your favorite President is asking all of those who supported Senator John Cornyn to UNITE, and immediately switch your support to Ken Paxton. ” Trump appeared on Newsmax on Thursday, where Rob Finnerty asked if he will regret endorsing Paxton over Cornyn if Talarico wins.
“No, because I think Cornyn would have lost,” Trump said, claiming “some people don’t love” Paxton, “but everybody admits he was the best attorney general in the history of Texas. ”“But when you got a guy who’s got multiple girlfriends, $200,000 worth of improvements in his house from a corrupt business guy for whom he does favors … and now it’s in the court of public opinion.
If this were not out there, this would be a normal Republican versus Democrat. ”on Thursday, former Republican Rep. Charlie Dent called out Trump’s Truth Social post, saying Cornyn was winning races until this primary and “until Donald Trump interceded. ”“The problem with the Paxton race is the candidate,” Dent said.
“He’s deeply flawed, unfit on many levels, character issues. That’s the problem, and Donald Trump endorsed him. This is not about John Cornyn. It’s not about Karl Rove.
The president is just trying to deflect. And put the blame somewhere else in the event that Paxton loses. It’s as simple as that. ” The White House referred the Daily Beast to Trump’s Truth Social post when asked for further comment.
